name: Justus
overview: The name Justus appears in Scripture referring to several individuals who played distinct roles in the early Christian community. One Justus, also called Jesus, was a disciple in Rome and a fellow worker for the kingdom of God, providing comfort to Paul in his ministry. Another Justus was a disciple nominated alongside Matthias to replace Judas Iscariot, highlighting his standing among the apostles. Additionally, a believer named Justus in Corinth is noted for his devotion to God, with his house located near the synagogue, indicating a place of worship and fellowship.
